recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce deleted core CodeSystem/ValueSet files or edit obsolete OID remnants for this issue; future changes to cited-artifact-part-type should be handled through THO/UTG.
issue_request: FHIR-41632 is an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request to add a `chapters` code to the Cited Artifact Part Type CodeSystem/ValueSet used by Citation.citedArtifact.part.type so Citation can cite books. The resolution also noted that Citation's extensible bindings should move to THO.
initial_application: Core commit 823cf54a42f916944972c5e4ee885a5d94c9effd (`J#41632 Add "chapters" code to the Cited Artifact Part Type CodeSystem`) inserted the `chapters` concept and definition into source/citation/codesystem-cited-artifact-part-type.xml.
additional_context: Later terminology migration work moved this terminology out of FHIR core. UP-633 is a Proposal Implemented UTG request to move EBMonFHIR terminologies from FHIR to THO, CDS minutes record approval, and the THO 6.3.0 publication page lists UP-633. Core commit caa1fb75adbcca96f92873c7d958e31f547124bb deleted the cited-artifact-part-type CodeSystem/ValueSet files, current source/fhir.ini has no active Citation or cited-artifact-part-type entry, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 later removed Citation source from the current build.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR-core source change is appropriate because the authoritative source for the requested terminology is now THO, where the active CodeSystem contains `chapters` and the active ValueSet includes that CodeSystem.

related_jiras.note: UTG proposal that moved EBMonFHIR terminologies, including Cited Artifact Part Type, from FHIR to THO and was published in THO 6.3.0.
Applied FHIR-core issue and implementation commit that removed duplicate CodeSystem definitions from the base specification, including the cited-artifact-part-type files.
